verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents AI voice and digital agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to humans without intervention. AI CSAT also runs automatically across 100% of calls, which shows some autonomous background operation. Webhooks, websocket event subscriptions and APIs are only developer building blocks for constructing automations, not a user-facing automation feature. missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or trigger-based background automations beyond conversational agents, depth on how agents are set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.
